title: State-integrity and vault runtime validation: Firefox
header: servers: two synthetic Transmission-compatible servers (tests/live/fake-transmission.mjs) at http://192.168.1.235:19193/ and http://192.168.1.235:19194/, overlapping torrent ids 1 and 2, harness-controlled delays and lists
harness: tests/live/verify-state.mjs; every claim checked against the servers' request logs and the controller's GET_STATE

results.name: list-shows-server-a
results.observed: rows ["A-one, Downloading, 0%","A-two, Downloading, 0%"]; controller server=Server A status=connected

results.name: switch-to-b-while-a-is-slow
results.observed: B's queue shown 3703 ms after the switch: ["B-one, Downloading, 0%","B-two, Downloading, 0%","B-three, Downloading, 0%"]; still B after A's 6 s reply: ["B-one, Downloading, 0%","B-two, Downloading, 0%","B-three, Downloading, 0%"]; A polls answered late: 4

results.name: command-targets-the-torrent-server-not-the-id
results.observed: torrent-stop ids [1] reached B only (A got none, although A also has id 1); resume restored Downloading

results.name: reorder-and-membership-changes
results.observed: rows followed the server order and membership: ["B-three, Downloading, 0%","B-four, Downloading, 0%","B-one, Downloading, 0%"]; restored

results.name: second-options-window-mirrors-state
results.observed: window 2 showed the same queue and reflected a pause/resume issued from window 1

results.name: popup-consistent-with-options
results.observed: popup shows Server B with B-one, B-two, B-three

results.name: background-restart-resubscribe
results.observed: skipped by design: WebDriver classic cannot terminate the Firefox event page

results.name: permission-revoked-and-recovered
results.observed: revoking http://192.168.1.235/* → "ACCESS REVOKED"; Grant access in the server list → LIVE

results.name: lock-redacts-every-window
results.observed: locking in window 1 redacted window 2 and the popup; no queue data remained visible

results.name: wrong-master-password
results.observed: wrong password refused (controller stays locked); correct password unlocked both windows

results.name: import-failure-preserves-state
results.observed: import rejected ("Import failed"); both servers still listed; controller still on Server B

results.name: safe-export-has-no-secrets
results.observed: ctrl-servers-safe-2026-09-09_17-24-53.json: containsSecrets=false, 2 servers, addresses present, no password field or value

results.name: sensitive-export-is-labelled
results.observed: ctrl-servers-full-2026-09-09_17-24-54.json: containsSecrets=true and both passwords present (as the label says)

results.name: legacy-vault-migration
results.observed: legacy salt+data unlocked with the old password, rewritten as a v2 envelope, legacy keys removed, server usable (LIVE)

results.name: corrupt-vault-fails-closed-and-resets
results.observed: corrupt envelope → "Vault damaged" in options and popup, no data shown; explicit reset → setup screen, vault keys removed
